proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting a Report on Risks of Politicized De-Banking
proposals.proponent: Ridgeline Research LLC, on behalf of the American Conservative Values ETF
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a Board report evaluating how Morgan Stanley oversees risks of discrimination against individuals based on race, religion, sex, national origin, or political views in providing financial services.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Transparency in Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing lobbying policies, lobbying and grassroots payments with recipients, trade association and model-legislation organization payments, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting a Clean Energy Supply Financing Ratio
proposals.proponent: The Comptroller of the City of New York, on behalf of the New York City Teachers' Retirement System, Employees' Retirement System, Police Pension Fund, and Board of Education Retirement System
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual disclosure of a Clean Energy Supply Financing Ratio comparing low-carbon energy financing to fossil-fuel financing, with methodology described.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
